release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $64.5m only fractionally above the ~$63.9m consensus (inside guide, as priced), Q4 guide $54-59m (mid $56.5m) slightly under the ~$57.6-57.9m Benzinga consensus, US retail -13.2%, GAAP loss $(4.32)/sh with a $57.1m impairment instead of the hoped-for litigation credit; offset by 19.3% gross margin and no new offering announced. key_line.metric: Q4 revenue guide and US retail
key_line.detail: Q4 guided $54-59m, just under consensus; US retail $24.8m (-13.2% y/y) still shrinking, international retail +13.3%. Gross margin 19.3% vs 7.4%. Cash $169.3m, debt $313.9m; no new exchange or offering in the release; S-3/ATM still unavailable.

guidance.detail: Q4 2026 net revenue $54-59m (mid $56.5m) vs ~$57.6-57.9m consensus; sequential step down from $64.5m; no full-year outlook.

call.detail: Call held last night; transcript not read in the time available. CEO cited high end of Q3 guide, third straight quarter of international retail growth, cost cuts and lease reductions.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions searched or found in the time window; coverage is thin (1-3 analysts). Wire coverage summarises the release (revenue -8.1% y/y, impairment) without new information.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 6.84 (-4.3% vs 7.15 prev close); after-hours 7.00 (-2.1%), pre-market high 7.03, low 6.70, last 6.79 at 09:07: the price has sagged through the night and morning. 26 prints, 8 in the last 30 min, not stale. Below my -6% release read, the 15.8% implied move and every one of the last 8 reactions (-4.1% to -23%). Market flat (SPY -0.05%, IWM +0.1%). Short is up about 7.6% from the 7.40 entry.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was the reaction function (0 of 8 up) plus financing overhang against a crowded short. Revenue landed inside the guide as expected, Q4 guide slightly below the street and US retail still falling; no squeeze trigger in the release. No new financing, so the overhang leg did not fire.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market that has drifted down steadily from after-hours, so the open should hold the move. The gap is small (-4%) relative to the implied move and to this name's history, so the usual post-gap give-back is weaker than for a large gap; a 34% short could bounce it early, hence fade near a coin flip.

recommendation.limit_basis: Pre-market low; -6.3% vs prev close, equal to the frozen release read (-6%) and well inside the 15.8% implied move and the name's past reactions.
recommendation.reason: De short staat al ruim 7% in de plus, maar de koers daalt pas ruim 4% terwijl de cijfers (zwakke Q4-prognose, krimpende VS-verkoop) en de vorige acht kwartalen eerder op een grotere daling wijzen. Leg een kooporder (dekking) met limiet op $6,70; wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot dicht.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers vóór 09:30 boven $7,00 terugveert (de shorts gaan dekken), dan liever bij de opening sluiten.
